_comment: Participant positioning history rules and calibration thresholds. Edit here, not in code.
_disclaimer: This data represents end-of-day positioning published by NSE after market close (18:00 IST). It provides macro context for the upcoming session, NEVER an intraday trigger. 'Client' category includes all non-institutional participants (retail, HNIs, family offices, proprietary client codes) and must not be treated as pure retail. Futures shorts are frequently hedges against cash equity portfolios.

percentile_thresholds._note: Percentile boundaries for classifying raw contracts and day-over-day changes.

divergence_thresholds._note: FII-minus-Retail spread triggers an extreme divergence flag ONLY when outside the 10th-90th percentile band.

outcome_scoring._note: Rules enforced: Any bucket with n < min_sample_size (10) MUST be reported as INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE, never as a win rate or percentage. No predictive claim without out-of-sample validation.
